input.native_root: absolute ASCII disposableRoot with no symlinks; platform observed separately
input.path_recipe: same native absolute root prefix for each path; actual filesystem existence is not required for this lexical helper
input.case_sensitive_context: observed ts.sys.useCaseSensitiveFileNames / equivalent native context; exercise true and false contexts as controlled predicate variants, record native target separately
